mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS id_site, s.`name` AS site_name, s.site_code, IFNULL(t.`offset`, '+00:00') AS timezone_offset, t.`value` AS timezone FROM site s LEFT JOIN time_zone t ON t.id = s.id_time_zone WHERE s.id = #{id_site} AND s.is_delete = 0

select.foreach: SELECT #{item.id_device} AS id_device, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(dv.time, '+00:00', #{timezone_offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.time) AS record_count, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(CONVERT_TZ(dv.time, '+00:00', #{timezone_offset})), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS first_time, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(CONVERT_TZ(dv.time, '+00:00', #{timezone_offset})), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS last_time, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(dv.nvmActiveEnergy ORDER BY dv.time ASC), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS first_read, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(dv.nvmActiveEnergy ORDER BY dv.time DESC), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS last_read FROM ${item.datatablename} dv WHERE dv.id_device = #{item.id_device} AND dv.nvmActiveEnergy IS NOT NULL AND dv.time >= CONVERT_TZ(#{start_date}, #{timezone_offset}, '+00:00') AND dv.time < CONVERT_TZ(DATE_ADD(#{end_date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), #{timezone_offset}, '+00:00') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(dv.time, '+00:00', #{timezone_offset}), '%Y-%m-%d')
